metadata.title: 3D Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: Alternating X and O on a selectable 3×3×3 board. Three matching marks on any straight 3D line wins; a full board without a winner draws.

participants.name: Local player controlling both alternating marks

variables.name: Board cell: empty, X or O

actions.name: Place the current mark in any empty cell

precondition.expr: state.get('rule:state.winner') == 0 and not state.get('rule:state.draw') and topology.contains('rule:topology.board', param.coordinate) and grid.get('rule:state.board', param.coordinate) == 0

systems.name: Detect three matching marks along any 3D straight line
Detect a full board without a winner
Alternate marks unless the game ended

goals.name: Complete three marks along an axis, a plane diagonal, or a space diagonal

invariants.name: Current mark is X or O
All 27 cells are empty, X or O

behavior_tests.name: Center of the volume is playable; occupied cells are rejected
Marks alternate and X wins on a space diagonal; play then stops
O wins along the Z axis without gravity

assumptions: The registered grid.has_line function evaluates straight lines over every axis of the referenced rectangular grid. On a 3×3×3 grid with length three, these are the 27 axis-aligned lines, 18 plane diagonals and four space diagonals.

As in the source UI, one local human controls both alternating marks. A full-game restart is a host command, not a Rule action; the existing Input IR's restart target must be changed to host_command restart when Input IR is rebuilt.

plan.topology: Bounded, cell-anchored 3×3×3 rectangular grid; all 27 sites are in the placement parameter domain.
plan.source_xy_policy: Keep the source's three X positions and three Y positions, their cell anchoring, and X/O alternation.
plan.target_z: Add three bounded Z layers, indexed 0 through 2.
plan.neighborhood: Winning lines use all straight 3D directions rather than movement adjacency.
plan.movement: Place a mark directly in any empty site, including the center and upper layers; no gravity. Reject occupied, out-of-bounds and post-terminal moves.
plan.outcomes: Three matching marks on any of 49 straight lines wins before the full-board draw check. A draw requires all 27 sites occupied and no winner.
plan.presentation: Preserve the source-drawn slate cells, blue crosses, amber rings, turn/result text and colors while arranging three visible 3D layers.
plan.input: Route cell selection to rule:action.place with event_data.rule_coordinate. Route R to host_command restart, including after terminal, and Escape to host_command quit; allow camera orbit and zoom without maintaining gameplay state in the renderer.
plan.z_equals_one_tests: At Z extent one, verify the source's eight winning lines, occupied-cell rejection, alternation and nine-cell draw.
plan.z_gt_one_tests: Check axis, plane-diagonal and space-diagonal wins, all 49 lines, center selection, no gravity, occupied-cell rejection, full-volume draw and post-terminal rejection.

behavior_tests.name: All layers and center selectable
behavior_tests.check: Visualizer instantiates 27 sites; coordinates [1,1,0], [1,1,1] and [1,1,2] have distinct world positions and selectable box colliders.

behavior_tests.name: Cell appearance follows Rule state
behavior_tests.check: A cell changes from slate-only to blue cross for value 1 or amber ring for value 2; the other 26 cells are unaffected.

behavior_tests.name: Turn and terminal feedback
behavior_tests.check: Initial status is Turn: X; current_player 2 shows Turn: O; winner 1 or 2 replaces turn status with its winner message; draw true with winner 0 shows Draw.

assumptions: The three depth layers are also offset horizontally so every cell, including the middle-layer center, is exposed to direct pointer selection in the initial front view.
The host viewport provides camera orbit and zoom controls; the scene does not duplicate them as gameplay state.
